evidence: Ru(thd)3 dissolved in ECH with a concentration of 0.05 M was the standard Ru source. A Ru solution was sprayed into the vaporizer by pulses of 2 ms at a frequency of 0.5 Hz. The reactor was purged for 5 s by Argas with a flow rate of 500 sccm between each feeding step of Ru solution and O2.
